opening.text: I have pain that came on fairly quickly. It's nagging and exhausting, and I'd rate it 7 out of 10. Over the last 2 weeks my symptoms have got worse, and it takes less and less effort to bring them on. They get worse when I exert myself and ease off when I rest. I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful. I have high blood pressure or take medicine for it, I've had a heart attack or I have angina, and I smoke cigarettes.
